text:
jordan_sales: Heads-up — AcmeBio just dropped a combined SOC2 + HIPAA questionnaire during contract review. They want 7-year audit log retention, KMS-backed key rotation, and exportable tamper-evident logs. Link to doc: https://acme.example.com/QnA (pdf).

sarah_product: thanks — can you paste the specific asks? short bullets are fine.

jordan_sales: sure. from the questionnaire: 1) Retain audit logs for 7 years; 2) Provide proof of immutable tamper-evident storage; 3) Support BYOK with quarterly rotation; 4) Ability to provide per-customer export on request; 5) Signed attestation for data handling.

casey_security: quick read — the 7y retention is long but doable if on S3 with ILM. BYOK + quarterly rotation is trickier: we currently support KMS integrations, but rotation cadence is customer-managed. Need legal sign-off for attestation.

ana_cs: (cc @jordan_sales) Acme says this is a gating item for their procurement timeline (2–3 weeks). They're on Dedicated plan but open to Private for the attestation.

mike_platform: technical note — our current audit pipeline stores detailed request logs for 90 days hot, 1 year cold. Extending to 7y will need lifecycle policy + storage cost estimate and a small service for export tooling. Also need schema for "tamper-evident" — do they mean append-only signed ledger?

sarah_product: options I see: A) Offer managed 7y retention as an add-on (storage + export UI) B) Recommend Private deployment + customer-managed archive C) Provide a short-term attestation while we scope engineering work. Which is fastest?

casey_security: for attestation we can provide SOC2-aligned statements quickly but not HIPAA-specific signed attestation about tamper-evident unless engineering produces proof. We could offer a compensating control: regular signed snapshots + audit hashes.

jordan_sales: customer prefers a single vendor solution, they asked for implementation details. They're pushing for an answer this week.

sarah_product: proposed triage: 1) create an intake ticket in product backlog 2) product/security to produce a one-pager with risks, implementation paths, and cost delta (48 hours) 3) offer interim contractual language for procurement that commits to "reasonable efforts" + roadmap milestone.

mike_platform: I'll draft rough impact estimate: storage + index costs ~ $0.03 / GB-month for cold, export tooling dev ~ 2 sprints (4 engineers) to build safe export + signing, ledger signing service ~ 3 sprints.

casey_security: also list controls: encrypted at rest with KMS, dual-control key access, export audit trail, HMAC signatures on snapshots. Example config snippet for exports:

```yaml
retention_policy:
  audit_logs: 7y
  exportable: true
  encryption: KMS
```

ana_cs: passing to Acme procurement: if we come back with managed add-on + price and a 3-month roadmap, would they accept? Jordan, confirm.

jordan_sales: will ask. My read: they'll accept managed add-on if we guarantee exportability and a signed SOC2/HIPAA note in contract.

sarah_product: ok. Action items: @mike_platform put numbers + rough timeline into the intake ticket; @casey_security draft the attestation language options; @jordan_sales confirm acceptance threshold with Acme; I'll prioritize the intake as P1 for the next planning sync.

legal_bot: new intake created: PROD-4621 — "AcmeBio audit retention & attestation" assigned to product/security. Due: 48h.

mike_platform: ticket updated with rough estimate in PROD-4621. storing estimates + callouts for compliance testing.

casey_security: uploaded draft attestation templates to the ticket. Pls comment if wording too vague for procurement.

jordan_sales: Acme procurement replied: they'd accept managed add-on if attestation includes quarterly exportability test and SLAs for data retrieval (72h). They've asked for final pricing by EOD Friday.

sarah_product: noted. we'll treat this as customer-driven scope with potential cost recovery. I'll slot a focused RFC if Acme confirms. For now marking as "needs decision" in the backlog. :white_check_mark:
